name: cerino
description: Cerino is your company brain, the human-approved source of truth for how your business operates. Your assistant answers from what your team approved and links each source, proposes new knowledge for a person to approve in Cerino, and shows what is waiting for review.

interface.longDescription:
Most of what a company knows lives in a few people's heads. It's why a price is what it is, how a job gets quoted, and who to call when a delivery slips. Cerino turns that tribal knowledge into a company brain your whole team, and ChatGPT, can rely on.

Every entry in the Brain is a decision, definition, process, policy, commitment or fact that a named person approved. Connect Cerino and ChatGPT answers from that record. It tells you how your company actually does things, links each source and names who signed off on it, and keeps all of it apart from general knowledge. ChatGPT can also look up the people, clients, projects and systems you work with, read your documents, and show your goals, open issues and what is waiting for review.

When a conversation turns up something worth keeping, such as a decision, a new client contact or a better way to run a process, ChatGPT can propose it to Cerino when you ask. Proposals wait in Cerino's Inbox until an owner or manager approves them. This connection cannot approve anything itself, which is what keeps the Brain worth trusting.

Built for companies that run on tribal knowledge and want their AI assistant to use it. Access is through a Cerino workspace, and you sign in with Google.
capabilities: Answer from approved company knowledge, with sources
Look up people, clients, projects and systems
Show goals, open issues and what is waiting for review
Propose new or corrected knowledge for a person to approve
defaultPrompt: What has our company decided about pricing?
What is waiting for review in Cerino?
Interview me to build our company brain in Cerino.

positive.description: Answer from the approved record, with sources
positive.prompt: How fast do we get a technician to a Priority customer with no heat?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers four business hours, six hours after hours, from the approved record, with a link to each entry it relies on and who approved it, kept apart from general knowledge.

positive.description: Answer a policy question from the record
positive.prompt: How much notice do we give a customer before their service agreement renews?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers sixty days, citing the approved entry with its link, and keeps any general advice separate from what the company approved.

positive.description: Answer about a client from the approved record
positive.prompt: What do we know about Front Range Grocers?
positive.tools_triggered: get_brain_context (ChatGPT may also call find_entities first)
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from approved entries with a link to each: our largest account at about $1.1M a year across 9 stores, Margo owns the relationship, and the renewal is due in February. Anything not recorded is said to be not recorded, not guessed.

positive.prompt: What are our goals right now, and which issues are open?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the active goals and the open issues, and keeps them apart from approved entries.

positive.description: Propose a correction to approved knowledge for a person to approve
positive.prompt: Our parts markup is going up from 35% to 40% on January 1. Propose that change to Cerino.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the approved entry that parts are marked up 35% and proposes a change to it rather than a second entry. Returns a review link and says the change is waiting for approval in Cerino, not saved, and that the current 35% entry stands until a person approves it.

negative.description: ChatGPT cannot approve anything: proposals are approved only in Cerino, by an owner or manager. It may list what is waiting, then says it cannot approve and points to the Inbox in Cerino
negative.prompt: Approve everything waiting in my Cerino Inbox.

negative.description: ChatGPT cannot delete approved knowledge; no tool deletes, and nothing changes
negative.prompt: Delete the entry about renewal notices.

negative.description: A general question unrelated to the company; no Cerino tool should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Denver this weekend?

review.commerce_description: Cerino does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: answers from your company's approved knowledge with sources, lookups of people, clients, documents, goals and issues, and proposals that wait for a person to approve in Cerino.
